Figure 7:Critic-value structure across turns.(a) Within-turn (horizontal) versus between-turn (vertical) RMS
deviations, weighted by token count. Each point is a trajectory;
the dashed line marks equality.
(b) Median between-turn variance share versus training step, with
token weighting (blue) and equal turn weighting (green).
Error bars are 95% prompt-cluster bootstrap intervals within each checkpoint.
(c) Cumulative distributions of per-trajectory mean absolute boundary
jumps (orange) and mean within-turn P95–P05 spans (green).
(d) Shares of pooled squared adjacent value changes at turn boundaries
(orange) and within turns (pale green), by training step.
